svg.title: From Earth to Mars: the Hohmann transfer, drawn to scale
svg.desc: A dark sky with faint stars and a warm Sun. Earth's near-circular orbit (1 AU) and Mars's slightly oval orbit (1.38 to 1.67 AU) are drawn to scale. A dashed glowing half-ellipse, the Hohmann transfer orbit with semi-major axis 1.262 AU, carries a small craft from Earth to Mars in about 259 days. Beside it: Kepler's third law T squared equals a cubed, the vis-viva equation, and the transfer time t equals pi times the square root of a cubed over GM.

g.text: T in years, a in AU
